stages.title: Before you begin
stages.promise: You can get into the game, with an account that keeps your progress.

stages.title: Creating your character
stages.promise: You understand every creation choice and its long-term cost.

stages.title: Privateer's Hold
stages.promise: You can fight, survive and leave the first dungeon.

stages.title: Your first town
stages.promise: You can use a town's services, join a guild, meet other players and stay on the right side of the law.

stages.title: Getting around
stages.promise: You can cross the Iliac Bay on foot, by horse, carriage or ship.

stages.title: Finding your feet
stages.promise: You level well, earn Renown, spend your first stars and start a profession.

stages.title: Gear and the sea
stages.promise: You understand loot rarity, sockets and reforging, and can take to the sea.

stages.title: The wider Bay
stages.promise: You can join the Bay's shared fights: raids, the Arena, elites and seasonal events.

stages.title: Rivals and the Breach
stages.promise: You can face revenants, keep a companion, fight at Dagon's Breaches and take part in guild politics.

stages.title: The late game
stages.promise: You know the long-term goals and how to reach them.
